summary: Full-stack testing of Shan Brothers Manpower Consultants MVP. All 21 pytest backend cases passed (health, public candidate/employer/contact submissions, admin JWT auth, admin list/patch/delete for all 3 resources, stats, validation 401/422/400 negative cases). All 7 Playwright UI flows passed (home hero, FAQ expand, apply form submit + success card, hire form submit + success, contact form submit + success card, admin login wrong-pw error, admin login success with sidebar navigation across candidates/employers/contacts tables + export CSV + logout).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes fallback ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD in os.environ.get() defaults — acceptable but consider failing fast if unset in prod.
CORS is wildcard '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests; not currently an issue since auth is Bearer token (not cookies), but tighten origins for production.
No rate limiting on public POST endpoints (candidates/employers/contacts) — spam vulnerability; consider basic throttling.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login. Playbook mentions 5-fail lockout — not implemented. Low priority for internal admin login but note it.
seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up TEST_ prefixed candidate/employer/contact records via pytest. UI tests created additional TEST_ records (not cleaned) — visible in admin dashboard as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 21 cases). Admin auth is Bearer JWT via /api/auth/login → localStorage 'sb_token'. All public forms POST to /api/{candidates,employers,contacts} with 201. Admin CRUD on /api/admin/* requires Authorization header. UI uses data-testid throughout. No fixes were required.
